# Secure a business loan or credit facility

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When the company is evaluating debt to fund a specific operating or investment need. An approved financing decision and, if accepted, a reconciled funded facility with an obligations calendar.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Define the borrowing need and repayment case

agent-runnable


Prepare the cash requirement, use of proceeds, forecast repayments and downside scenario. Compare debt with available cash and equity alternatives without assuming a loan program or guarantee is available.

- Sources: [SBA loans](https://www.sba.gov/loans/)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Assemble the lender diligence pack

agent-runnable


Gather financial statements, ownership records, existing debt, collateral information and forecast assumptions. Track lender-specific requests and verify the lender and application channel before sharing confidential records.

- Sources: [SBA loans](https://www.sba.gov/loans/)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Review terms and select an offer

human · human approval required


Finance leadership and counsel review interest mechanics, fees, security, guarantees, covenants, default terms and prepayment rules. Record the total obligations and who has authority to commit the company or provide a guarantee.

- Sources: [SBA loans](https://www.sba.gov/loans/)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Approve and execute the financing documents

human · human approval required · hard to undo


Obtain required corporate and personal approvals for the final terms. The authorized people execute the documents and funding instructions; no guarantee or collateral commitment is assumed from an application alone.

- Sources: [SBA loans](https://www.sba.gov/loans/)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Reconcile funding and register ongoing obligations

agent-runnable


Verify funds received, fees and opening balances against the signed documents. Calendar repayments, covenant tests and notice requirements and assign reporting owners before treating the facility as available cash.

- Verify: An approved financing decision and, if accepted, a reconciled funded facility with an obligations calendar.
- Sources: [SBA loans](https://www.sba.gov/loans/)
